title: Polynomial quantum synthesis of any unitary using a suitable Boolean oracle
exact_target: Is there one classically polynomial-time uniform family $A_n$ of quantum oracle circuits over H,T,T-dagger,CNOT, with polynomially many qubits, gates, calls and oracle input bits, such that for every n-qubit unitary U some Boolean oracle f makes its output channel within diamond distance 1/2 of conjugation by U? The oracle may depend on U but the circuit template may only depend on n.
